summary: Bioxytran, Inc. (OTCQB: BIXT), a Nevada-incorporated, Boston-based biotechnology company, filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on November 4, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing that its A-SUQAR chewable nutraceutical tablet received a government-issued Free Sale Certificate, legalized by the issuing country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and prepared for attestation for use in the United Arab Emirates. No transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is involved; the filing is an ordinary product-regulatory disclosure. The certificate supports product registration and GCC market entry. Watch for UAE registration progress; no deal-risk arbitrage angle exists.
